name: bloggingpro_jobs-mcp
description: BloggingPro Job Board (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoin

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager 'job_listing' post type exposed through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page ≤ 100, search, and the job-categories / job-types taxonomy filters, as listed by the route's own schema at https://www.bloggingpro.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings (OPTIONS)). `query` is WordPress full-text `search`; `category` is a job-categories TERM ID (GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-categories lists them) — not a slug. min_budget is not sent (salary is free text in meta._job_salary). title/description are rendered HTML; buyer is meta._company_name, deadline meta._job_expires (often absent); the apply link (meta._application) and location stay in raw.meta. Only published, public listings are returned.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> (the numeric post id from search_postings). An unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id.
